new_articles.title: Andhra woos HD Hyundai with $4 billion shipbuilding cluster
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor, HD Hyundai 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Andhra woos HD Hyundai with $4 billion shipbuilding cluster'이다. Andhra Pradesh is seeking HD Hyundai Heavy Industries for a new shipbuilding cluster. The state offers the Kakinada port for this proposed $4 billion investment. HD Hyundai Heavy Industries previously signed an agreement with Tamil Nadu for a similar project. This initiative aligns with the Centre's Shipbuilding Financial Assistance Scheme. The scheme received approval in September 2025 for development. HD Hyundai Heavy Industries previously signed an agreement with Tamil Nadu for a similar project The scheme received approval in September 2025 for development Agencies Plan for $4b greenfield shipbuilding cluster; move follows IT minister’s meeting with co execs in Seoul in June New Delhi: Andhra Pradesh is trying to woo HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Co with readymade Kakinada port to set up a greenfield shipbuilding cluster with a proposed investment of $4 billion HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, which is the world's second biggest shipbuilder, had signed a memorandum of understanding with Tamil Nadu government on December 7, 2025 to set up a shipbuilding cluster at Thoothukudi This is one of the first projects proposed under the Centre's '69,725 crore Shipbuilding Financial Assistance Scheme, which was approved in September 2025.

matched_articles.summary: HYBE 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'K-pop mogul behind BTS referred to prosecutors over alleged investor fraud'이다. Police have been investigating Bang Si-Hyuk, the billionaire founder and chairperson of Hybe, over allegations that he misled investors in 2019. Police have been investigating Bang, the billionaire founder and chairperson of Hybe, over allegations that he misled investors in 2019 by indicating that Hybe had no immediate plans to go public, prompting them to sell their shares to a private equity fund shortly before the company proceeded with an initial public offering Police earlier said that the fund may have paid Bang somewhere around US$147-million in a side deal that promised him 30 per cent of post-IPO stock sale profits By the numbers: How BTS measures up in Canada South Korean media reported that police referred four other people, including Hybe executives and private equity fund officials, to prosecutors on Thursday as well, asking for their indictment Hybe officials have said Bang denies any wrongdoing “We have consistently responded to the allegations with objective evidence and facts,” Bang’s legal team said in a statement Thursday. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
